name: DALL-E 3
tagline: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's image generation model, natively integrated into ChatGPT. It interprets detailed prompts more accurately than its predecessors and produces high-quality, photorealistic or stylised images in seconds. Millions of ChatGPT users access it daily to visualise ideas, create illustrations, and generate marketing assets.
